title: Follow-Up Reminder Sync Gap Watch
dataSources: Monica contacts (`monica:contact`), Clay relationships (`clay:relationship`), LinkedIn connections (`linkedin:connection`), follow-up reminders (`followup:reminder`), and intro requests (`intro:request`).
app: Monica contact relationship logs, Clay network exports, LinkedIn connection events, follow-up reminder tasks, and warm-intro request trackers streamed into Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=followup:reminder
| stats max(_time) as last_seen by contact_name
| eval hours_since=round((now()-last_seen)/3600,1)
| where hours_since>72
| sort - hours_since
description: Detects when follow-up reminder data has stopped arriving for a given contact.
value: Personal telemetry is only useful when it is current; sync-gap alerts catch failed exports and broken credentials early.
implementation: Track the latest event time per contact and alert when the feed is older than 72 hours.
visualization: Table of entities by hours since last event.
grandmaExplanation: It gathers when one part of your follow-up reminder feed has stopped checking in and probably needs fixing.
